description: [MERGED INTO hierarchical-database-schema] This ticket has been merged with 'hierarchical-database-schema' to create a single migration (26.sql) that adds both parent_id and direction columns to the Habits table. Implementing both changes in one migration avoids multiple schema changes to the same table. See hierarchical-database-schema for the combined implementation.
title: Database Schema for Habit Direction

descriptionHistory.description: Create migration to add 'direction' column to habits table with default value POSITIVE. Includes index for filtering habits by tracking direction type.
